collectableDividendOf(uint256).notice: View the amount of reward in wei that a NFT position has collected.

collectableRewardOf(uint256).notice: View the amount of reward in wei that a NFT position has collected.

collectedDividendOf(uint256).notice: View the amount dividends (ETH) in wei, from the locked tokens, that a NFT position has collected.

collectedRewardOf(uint256).notice: View the amount of reward in wei, that a NFT position has collected.

distributeDividends().notice: Distributes dividends to the position NFT holders.

distributeRewards(uint256).notice: distributes rewards to the position NFT holders.

dividendToken().notice: Returns the instance of the locked dividend token contract.

initialize(address,address,address).notice: Initializes the lock manager with the given parameters.

lock(uint256,uint256).notice: Locks the selected position and mints a LockPositionsNFT representing the lock, to the caller (msg.sender).

lockFor(address,uint256,uint256,bool).notice: Locks the selected position and mints a LockPositionsNFT representing the lock, to the specified lockOwner.

positionsNFT().notice: Returns the address of the LockPositionsNFT contract that manages the locked positions.
